THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Three-Step School Bento

A reusable three-part school lunch: ham-and-cheese sandwich on Sola bread, BIENA Ranch crispy edamame with light string cheese, then blueberries and two Hide & Seek cookies. About 470 calories and 35g protein per lunch, estimated.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIMESee method
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~470 cal | ~35g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Macros are an estimate for one complete lunch including the light string cheese — about 470 cal / 35g protein. Ingredient-label audit is roughly 460–500 cal and 34–35g protein before trimming.

Ingredients

SANDWICH

  • 2 slices Sola Sweet & Buttery bread
  • 1 slice 365 Black Forest ham
  • 1 Velveeta cheese slice
  • ½ tbsp whipped cream cheese

ALONGSIDE

  • 1 packet BIENA Ranch crispy edamame (30g / 1.05 oz)
  • ½ cup blueberries
  • 2 Hide & Seek chocolate sandwich cookies
  • 1 light string cheese

Allergens: wheat, gluten, dairy, soy, pork.

You want a reusable three-part school-lunch formula — sandwich anchor, crunchy protein side, fruit and something fun — without inventing a measured prep-time claim.

Method

  1. 1.STEP 1 — SANDWICH. Spread the whipped cream cheese on the bread. Add the cheese and ham, close the sandwich, then trim and cut as you prefer.
  2. 2.BUILD THE FILLING. Layer the Velveeta slice and 365 Black Forest ham on the cream-cheese side, then close.
  3. 3.TRIM + CUT. Trim overhanging crust or filling if you like, then cut into finger strips for the lunchbox.
  4. 4.STEP 2 — PROTEIN SIDE. Pack the sandwich strips with the BIENA Ranch crispy edamame and the light string cheese.
  5. 5.EDAMAME. Add the 30g BIENA Ranch crispy edamame packet to a compartment (or pour from the packet into the box).
  6. 6.STEP 3 — FRUIT + FUN. Fill the remaining compartments with blueberries and the two Hide & Seek cookies. Close and keep chilled until lunch.
  7. 7.FINISH. Two cookies in the treat pocket complete the three-part formula. Pack with an ice pack for school.

Keys to success

  • Cookie variety/weight, ham slice weight, cheese brand, whipped-cream-cheese brand, and unweighed sandwich offcuts all move the total; do not treat 470/35 as a weighed lab result.
  • No measured prep-time claim is published for this build.
